coaching.phase1: Reels is your discovery engine — ~50% of feeds are now strangers. Hook in 3 seconds, post ORIGINAL (video is fingerprinted — reposts die), and let it ride same-day.
coaching.phase2: Private shares are the whole game: would someone send this in Messenger/WhatsApp? That outranks every like. Make it obviously match one clear interest (the UTIS question).
coaching.phase34: Watch time + private shares that travel across demographics unlock the ~3B ceiling. Use the cross-app graph — one clip works on FB, IG Reels, and as a Messenger send.
